purpose: Auditable record of AI-assisted maintainer review used during the US Regulation Assurance Lift. When a use case was promoted to status=verified or had its compliance assurance re-graded as part of this initiative, the change was made on the basis of AI-assisted research + maintainer attestation rather than a credentialed human SME sign-off.
disclaimer: This file is NOT a substitute for data/provenance/sme-signoffs.json and must not be read as credentialed human subject-matter-expert review. Schema semantics define status=verified as 'SME-signed-off'; setting it from AI review + maintainer attestation is an accepted deviation explicitly authorised by the maintainer for this initiative. Each record below states the concrete checks performed so the deviation is auditable.
